answers.purpose: Collect every open decision from the conversation and its working records and present them to the user as AskUserQuestion prompts, each framing the problem, the evidence and the consequence, with 2 to 4 options and the recommendation first; then record the answers and act only on explicit instructions.

phrases: give me the decisions as prompts
what do I need to decide
triggers.disambiguation: Distinct from /init (CLAUDE.md scaffolding) and from editorial-triage, whose Decide section and spot check close review findings inside a triage run; /decide gathers any open decisions of the current work, from any domain, and puts them to the user as question prompts. It decides nothing itself and owns no domain state.
